notes.title: RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Finally, we are happy to introduce our small game to you, a kinetic visual novel 'An Un-epic story: The adventure of Enki and Tiny Freddie'.
This cozy, fascinating fantasy story is about the friendship of two completely different girls. It won't take long to read it, but the charge of a good mood and positive is guaranteed! 

We will be happy if you will leave us a short review. I hope our game will leave only positive vibes and will make you happy!
Enjoy~

notes.title: Release is near~
notes.notes:
The game will be released very soon! And we are all glad we manage to make it happens! 
The last tests went just fine and our beta testers are finished and all bugs have been exterminated. 

Right now the exhausted team is going to rest and nothing will stop us to push the release button tomorrow! We really hope our cute and fun game will make you happy.
See you soon in a tavern!
